note: Rental 3a, lessons and odds: the full Qwen first grows nine skill sets (codefix, recover, clarify, newtool, selfcheck, research, understand, formats, reasoning) to about 1,000 lessons each, saved on the PC in out/lessons-<skill>; then one teacher pass scores the whole set (own sets, the grown sets, the outside sets, general text). The scores go to the network volume and to the PC (out/teacher/<key>/). No cut, no heal: Bill's run (bill-v3.json) finds the scores and skips the pass. | 8 Nov, build 17: the full Qwen is first trained on every lesson (train_teacher, one full pass, about 16 h) and kept as 35Bob Bobert; the odds then come from Bobert, so the lesson-set key names him. About 24-26 h in all (lessons 1 h, training about 16 h, GGUF export 1.5 h, odds 6 h), caps 30 h / $165; 300 GB volume (stock teacher 70 GB + Bobert 70 GB + scores + lessons, with room for Bill).
step_up_note: about $8/h against $5.30 for the H200 at the 5 Nov prices; check the live price before typing yes
extra_lessons_note: 8 Nov: the five lessons-ext-* sets are published big-teacher traces from Hugging Face (Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5.1, DeepSeek-v4-Pro, DeepSeek-v4-Flash, GLM-4.7), converted by import-external.mjs. Each lessons.jsonl is a seed-1 sample sized so the ext sets together are about the same answer-token count as Bob's own lessons (~9.6M); the full conversions are in lessons-full.jsonl beside them. Adding them changes the teacher key, so the next run scores the lessons afresh. 8 Nov: outside sets resampled to 9,059 lessons in all (the same as Bob's own by count) after a quality pass: GLM-5.1 agent set dropped (86% of traces never reach an answer), Kimi filtered to 1171 (two part files), DeepSeek agent 2,553 and GLM-4.7 864 whole, DeepSeek chat 4471 of 6,290. Checked for injected instructions, piped installers and secrets: nothing found beyond ordinary Dockerfile lines.
